# Plugin Catalog — Editing & UndoRedo

> Architecture → grid-plugins.md · selection, context menu → grid-plugin-selection.md · reordering, tooltip, sticky rows → grid-plugins-catalog-ui.md · row model, clipboard/export → grid-plugins-catalog-data.md · adapter-side editor bridges → adapters-{react,vue,angular}.md.
>
> Read order for "the editor commits/discards the wrong value": Editing FLOW (`#exitRowEdit`) → the keyboard `DECIDED` bullets (#347/#427/#250/#558) → `ColumnEditorContext` idempotency → UndoRedo transactions.

## Editing

OWNS: active cell, editor snapshots, changed rows, dirty tracking. HOOKS: processColumns, processRows, afterCellRender, afterRowRender, onCellClick, onKeyDown. EVENTS: `cell-commit`, `row-commit`, `edit-open|close`. TENSION: caches the sort result during an edit so the edited row doesn't jump.

- DECIDED (Jul 2026): `onKeyDown` is a `switch (event.key)` dispatcher only; logic lives in `#onEscapeKey`/`#onArrowKey`/`#onTabKey`/`#onSpaceKey`/`#onEnterKey` (→ `#onEnterWhileEditorFocused`, `#beginRowEditFromEnter`)/`#onF2Key`. MUST NOT re-inline — the `#347`, `#427`, `#251`, `#250` guards each live in one specific branch.
- FLOW (`#exitRowEdit`, order is load-bearing): `#resolveEditedRow` (ID map → `#activeEditRowRef` → `_rows[rowIndex]`) → `#commitActiveEditors` (skips `data-editor-managed`) → `before-edit-close` → revert | `#finalizeRowCommit` (cancelable `row-commit`, dirty refresh, queue animation) → `#clearRowEditState` → `#pendingFocusRestore = true` → `#teardownRowEditors` → `edit-close`. MUST set `#pendingFocusRestore` before `#teardownRowEditors` (its `refreshVirtualWindow(true)` runs `afterRender()` synchronously and reads it); `releaseCell` MUST run while editor DOM is still in the cell or overlay editors leak `<body>` panels.
- DECIDED (Jul 2026, `getInputValue`): `libs/grid/src/lib/plugins/editing/editors.ts` switches on `input.type` over `readNumericValue`/`readDateValue`/`readTextInputValue`, plus `readTextControlValue` for `<textarea>`/`<select>`. INVARIANT: every branch PRESERVES THE ORIGINAL VALUE'S TYPE and distinguishes `nullable` empty → `null` from non-nullable empty → `''`/`min`; MUST NOT be "simplified" to `input.value`. INVARIANT (#547): any sentinel a built-in editor puts in the DOM (nullable select "(Blank)" = `NULLABLE_BLANK_VALUE` `'__tbw_null__'`) MUST be decoded in `getInputValue` too, FIRST (before the numeric branch → `NaN`). WHY: row close (`#commitActiveEditors`) re-reads every native editor's DOM value and commits on `!==`; an untouched editor never fires change/blur, so its own decode never ran. INVARIANT (#551): a `multiple` select MUST be read via `readMultiSelectValue` (shared with `createSelectEditor`'s commit) — `input.value` is only the FIRST selected option; options map back via the `optionValues` WeakMap (option element → configured value; string match is only the custom-editor fallback, since `1`/`'1'` collide), lone blank sentinel → `null` ONLY when `column.nullable` AND the option is absent from `optionValues` (a configured option may own the `'__tbw_null__'` value; `optionValues` is checked first). Row close compares with `isSameEditorValue` (arrays = set-equal; fresh array + DOM option order), NOT `!==`; `createSelectEditor`'s multi commit also skips a re-read that is set-equal to the ROW's current value (`readCellField(ctx.row, ctx.field)`) — blur would otherwise fire `cell-commit` + dirty the row. MUST NOT cache a local "last committed" baseline: `ctx.commit` returns no acceptance, so a `cell-commit` veto or an in-place `updateRow` leaves the cache wrong and swallows the retry. `#commitCellValue` stays `===` on purpose — set-equality there would swallow order-only commits from custom array editors.
- INVARIANT (#555, `setInputValue`): the external-update push (`onValueChange` auto-wire in `editor-injection.ts` — template, HTML-string factory, and native-node factory paths; fed by `cell-change` with `source !== 'user'` and by the grid-mode Escape revert `#revertGridModeCellEdit`) MUST write via `editors.ts#setInputValue`, the inverse of `getInputValue`; MUST NOT `input.value = String(v)`. WHY: `'a,c'` matches no option so the `HTMLSelectElement.value` setter deselects ALL options → row close commits `[]`; `<input type=date>` rejects `Date.toString()` → `''` → nullable commits `null`; nullable `null` has no `''` option → must select the sentinel. Multi-select write mirrors the read: `optionValues` strict match first, string match for custom options. Sentinel handling (select it for `null`) ONLY when `column.nullable` AND the option is absent from `optionValues` (`isBlankSentinel`), the same nullability gate as both readers — so callers MUST pass the column (`setInputValue(input, value, column)`); on a non-nullable column a `'__tbw_null__'` option is an ordinary value (PR #556 review). Template path still skips object values EXCEPT an array into `select[multiple]` and a `Date` into `input[type=date]` — a `Date` into a template TEXT input stays skipped (`Date.toString()` there would be re-read and committed as a string on row close).
- TENSION (happy-dom 21): `select.selectedOptions` is a cached collection that misses programmatic `option.selected` writes (browsers are live). `readMultiSelectValue` therefore filters `select.options` by `.selected`; specs asserting selection after a push MUST read option flags, not `selectedOptions`.
- RULE: editor detection MUST use `closest(FOCUSABLE_EDITOR_SELECTOR)`, never `matches()` — non-focusable descendants (`<option>`, spans in `contenteditable`) fail it.
- DECIDED (#347 + #427, popup-`<select>` keyboard): in `mode:'grid'` ArrowUp/Down MUST NOT navigate cells when the keydown target is inside an editor descendant; Enter on a popup `<option>` MUST bail WITHOUT `preventDefault`/`stopPropagation` — in BOTH `editor-injection.ts` host-keydown AND `EditingPlugin.onKeyDown`. #427: that guard (`getEditorAncestor(target) !== target`) MUST sit ABOVE the mode split — inside `isGridMode` only, ROW mode fell through and DISCARDED the picked value. WHY: Chromium's popup walks focus SELECT→OPTION (flips `#gridModeInputFocused`) and `preventDefault` blocks the native commit; Enter-on-open-popup defers to native (`change`), a SECOND Enter exits the row. Enter with no popup: commit + blur + focus grid (`#gridModeEditLocked = true`). RULE: editor-chain keydown handlers MUST NOT `stopPropagation` in grid mode.
- DECIDED (Apr 2026): row-mode ArrowUp/Down MUST NOT commit + jump to the adjacent row while a row is in edit mode — returns `true` (handled, no-op) so the focused editor consumes the key natively; same rationale as the `editing && colType === 'select'` early return in `core/internal/keyboard.ts`.
- INVARIANT (#559): `onCellClick` MUST return `false` (not handled) for a click on a `.cell.editing` in `#activeEditRow`, never re-call `beginBulkEdit`. WHY: `beginBulkEdit`'s deferred `setTimeout` focus targets `_focusCol` (stale: core body `mousedown` skips `.cell.editing`) or the FIRST `.cell.editing`, yanking focus out of the clicked editor every click. Returning `false` hands off to core `handleRowClick`'s editing-cell branch (`core/internal/rows.ts`), which syncs `_focusCol` and focuses the click target. Clicks on NON-editing cells of that row still re-enter (single-cell → row upgrade). Test: `editing-integration.spec.ts` › "…row already in edit (…, #559)".
- DECIDED (#250): the `editor-injection.ts` keydown handler MUST short-circuit on `e.defaultPrevented` BEFORE inspecting `e.key` — portal pickers (Downshift, MUI date) `preventDefault()` on option-confirming Enter; without it the editor tears down first.
- INVARIANT (`ColumnEditorContext` idempotency): `ctx.commit`/`ctx.cancel` are one-shot — in `libs/grid/src/lib/plugins/editing/internal/editor-injection.ts` `commit` returns early when `editFinalized` is set (or, row mode, when no edit session is active); `cancel` sets it unconditionally, so the built-in `Escape→cancel` + `blur→commit` pair is safe. Custom editors MUST guard their OWN teardown (e.g. `mask.destroy()`) and MUST NOT `preventDefault`/`stopPropagation` on Enter/Escape — the editor-host keydown listener needs them to drive `exitRowEdit()`. Recipe: `apps/docs/src/content/docs/grid/recipes/input-masks-validation.mdx`.
- INVARIANT (#557): the row-mode Enter path MUST set `editFinalized = true` AFTER `deps.exitRowEdit(rowIndex, false)`, never before. WHY: `exitRowEdit` emits `before-edit-close`; the adapters' blur bridge (`makeFlushFocusedInput`, React/Vue/Angular) blurs the FOCUSED editor, i.e. the very cell whose keydown fired Enter, and its `onBlur → ctx.commit(draft)` must land. Teardown blurs are still rejected because `#clearRowEditState` clears `#activeEditRow` (session guard) before `#teardownRowEditors`. Tab/click-outside never set the flag. Test: `editing-integration.spec.ts` › "…closed with Enter (#557)".
- INVARIANT (#518): `editor-injection.ts` MUST preserve only the cell's direct `.tbw-cell-loading-overlay` (`:scope > …`) across adapter release and `cell.innerHTML` replacement, then append it beside `.tbw-editor-host` WITHOUT unmounting it. Temporarily move it to a connected row sibling during `releaseCell()` (shared `core/internal/loading.ts#parkCellLoadingOverlay`, also used by the rows patch path) so React's portal prune cannot drop the loader; restore it before returning. A loading cell can enter edit mode before loading completes. The same park/restore wraps `releaseCell()` in `EditingPlugin#teardownRowEditors` (edit close) — React's `releaseCell` cleans `.react-loading-renderer` roots, and the replay never refills an overlay that is still present. Tests: `editing-integration.spec.ts` (begin + close); `editor-injection.spec.ts` nested-cell and connected-loader cases; React `data-grid.spec.tsx`.
- DECIDED (#251, overlay-editor parity): (1) generic `aria-expanded="true" + aria-controls=<id>` fallback via `isInsideOpenAriaOverlay(target, scopeEl)`, called from `editor-injection.ts` host keydown, `EditingPlugin.onKeyDown` and document-pointerdown outside-click; (2) opt-in `ColumnEditorContext.grid` → `registerExternalFocusContainer(panel)` or `useGridOverlay(panelRef,{open})`. Tests: `editing-overlay-aria.spec.ts`, `use-grid-overlay.spec.tsx`.
- DECIDED (#558, row-mode Escape stack): first Escape from an expanded ARIA trigger (composedPath walk up to the scope — the row for document capture/`#onEscapeKey`, the editor host for host/template listeners; crosses shadow roots) or from inside its owned panel (portalled OR inline beside the trigger — the `isInsideOpenAriaOverlay` ownership check MUST run even when the target is in scope; PR #562 review) closes ONLY the overlay; the next cancels the row. `isEscapeForOpenOverlay` runs in ALL row-mode Escape paths (document capture, editor host, template input, `#onEscapeKey`). INVARIANT: both it and `shouldPreventEditClose` cache their verdict per event (`WeakMap<Event, claiming scope>` — reused only by a nested/containing scope, so an unrelated grid's document listener judges its own row and the result is independent of listener order / `WeakMap<Event, Map<callback, bool>>`). WHY: the capture listener runs BEFORE the overlay's handler, which flips `aria-expanded="false"` mid-propagation — re-reading live DOM in bubble-phase paths cancelled the row anyway. Grid mode untouched (own deferred-nav branch).
- DECIDED (Jul 2026, `commitCellValue`): EditingPlugin answers the core `commitCellValue` query (`#handleCommitCellValue`) so `grid.updateRow/updateRows` route programmatic mutations through the full edit pipeline; `source:'history'` applies + recomputes dirty but does NOT re-record history (undo-loop fix). Plugin bundle budget 50 → 55 kB for editing (the outlier). Contract: grid-plugins.md § inter-plugin-communication.
- DECIDED (Jul 2026, `source:'sync'`): applies the value in place AND re-baselines the cell (`DirtyTrackingManager.rebaselineCell`) — no dirty marking, no undo history, no cascade. Re-baseline (not skip) because `dirtyTracking` deep-compares a whole-row `structuredClone` baseline. Runs BEFORE the column guard so non-column fields re-baseline too. `cell-change` still fires; `cell-edit-committed` does not, so UndoRedo stays clean. Adapters route value-only, same-order/count rows-prop updates through `updateRows(diff,'sync')` (unresolvable id → full `el.rows` replace): `grid-react/src/lib/data-grid.tsx`, `grid-angular/src/lib/directives/{grid.directive.ts,row-diff.ts}`, `grid-vue/src/lib/TbwGrid.vue`.
- DECIDED (PR #525, `cell-edit-reverted`): in-place rollbacks (`revertRow`/`revertAll`, `#revertRowFromSnapshot` on row-edit cancel, `#revertGridModeCellEdit`) emit plugin event `cell-edit-reverted` `{rowId?}` — NOT `cell-edit-committed`, which UndoRedo records. WHY: in-place writes keep the input array identity, so input-ref caches (Filtering `cachedInputRows`) need a signal. Any NEW in-place write path MUST emit one of the two.
- INVARIANT (PR #525, dirty baselines): `#captureBaselines` runs in `processRows` AND on `datasource:data` (only with `dirtyTracking`). WHY: a ServerSide block landing on the lightweight `requestVirtualRefresh()` path never runs processRows, so its rows had no baseline → `getOriginalRow()` undefined, `revertRow()` a no-op. That path also skips `afterRender()` when virtualized (`refreshVirtualWindow(false)` only runs it on bypass/unvirtualized), and `baselines-captured` is drained+emitted ONLY there → the handler calls `requestAfterRender()` (STYLE) when `capture()` returns `true`; drain-once keeps a coalesced render to one event. Tests: `integration/server-side-dirty-tracking.spec.ts`.
- INVARIANT (#449, SC 3.3.1): `#syncInvalidCellAttribute` sets `aria-invalid` ALONGSIDE `data-invalid` and removes BOTH on clear. `data-invalid` is styling only — before #449 a validation error reached CSS but never reached a screen reader.
- INVARIANT (#449): when that method writes the validation message into `title`, it MUST also `removeAttribute(GridDataAttrs.TRUNCATED)`. Core's `syncTruncationTitle` treats that marker as "this title is mine" and would overwrite the message with the cell text on the next hover. Any other code that sets a cell `title` owes the same handover.
- DECIDED (#449, SC 4.1.2/3.3.2): `nameEditorFromHeader` at the tail of `injectEditor` gives the focusable editor `aria-label` = `column.header ?? column.field`. Deferred a microtask (adapters mount async) and skipped when the control already has `aria-label`/`aria-labelledby`/`title`/a `<label for>`/an ancestor `<label>`. WHY: a gridcell's header is announced for the CELL, but the `<input>` inside is its own control and was announced as a bare "edit text".

## UndoRedo

OWNS: undo/redo stacks. HOOKS: onKeyDown (Ctrl+Z/Y). DEPENDS: editing (required). Applies reverts via `grid.updateRow(id, {field: val}, 'history')` — the `'history'` source makes Editing apply-without-re-recording (`#suppressRecording` guards the buffered path).

- DECIDED (#526, row identity): `EditAction.rowId` (captured at record time: `recordEdit(…, rowId?)` arg / `cell-edit-committed` detail `rowId` → else `getRowId(rows[rowIndex])`) is the target; `#applyValue` = ONE `updateRow(id,…,'history')` (source scan inside; filtered-out rows reachable; deleted row → silent no-op, core skips `TBW041` for `'history'`) — NO pre-check scan. `rowIndex` = fallback ONLY for id-less rows (direct `writeCellField`). Focus is DEFERRED: `#pendingFocus` → `afterRender()` maps `rowId` → `_getRowEntry().index` after the ROWS phase `requestRenderWithFocus()` schedules (re-sort/re-filter settled); skipped when not in view. Editing's dirty-tracking `undo`/`redo` listener walks compound `actions` and uses O(1) `_getRowEntry` only — the `'history'` branch of `#handleCommitCellValue` already emits `dirty-change` for off-view rows. WHY: display index goes stale after sort/filter → no-op, wrong-row write, or focus on a neighbour. Tests: `integration/undo-redo-row-identity.spec.ts`.
- DECIDED (Jul 2026, TBW111): `beginTransaction()`/`endTransaction()` are re-entrant via `#transactionDepth`; only the outermost `endTransaction` finalizes the buffer, and nesting coalesces a paste into ONE compound undo entry. WHY: paste emits one synchronous `cell-commit` per cell; consumers bracketing each with `beginTransaction()` + `queueMicrotask(endTransaction)` hit a nested begin and the old `TRANSACTION_IN_PROGRESS` throw escaped the loop ("paste only fills one cell"). `endTransaction` still throws `NO_TRANSACTION` at depth 0; depth reset in `detach()` + `clearHistory()`.
